summary_en: This study tests repeated intra-arterial infusions of cetuximab (CTX) after blood brain barrier disruption, given with standard chemotherapy and radiation, in newly diagnosed glioblastoma. Patients receive mannitol to disrupt the blood brain barrier, then three intra-arterial doses of cetuximab at 250 mg/m2, given at about days 30, 120 and 210 after surgery. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase I/II trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa infusiones intraarteriales repetidas de cetuximab (CTX) después de alterar la barrera hematoencefálica, administradas junto con quimioterapia y radioterapia estándar, en glioblastoma de diagnóstico reciente. Los pacientes reciben manitol para alterar la barrera hematoencefálica y luego tres dosis intraarteriales de cetuximab de 250 mg/m2, aproximadamente a los días 30, 120 y 210 después de la cirugía. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un ensayo de Fase I/II.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.
Tumor shows EGFR overexpression confirmed by pathology.
At least one biopsy-proven, evaluable tumor site.
Karnofsky performance status 70% or higher, or ECOG 0-2.
Expected survival of at least three months.
not_for: Chemotherapy or radiation already started or completed before enrollment.
Significant medical or psychiatric conditions that raise risk or affect treatment or monitoring.
